purpose: Scheduled Course Material Release: Draft -> Scheduled -> Published when release date arrives
preconditions: Course exists; Faculty creates material with future release date
action_or_input: Material scheduled; time advances past scheduled_release_at
expected_result: Material status transitions to published and is visible to students

purpose: Scheduled Course Material Release: Time not reached -> Remains Scheduled and hidden
preconditions: Material scheduled in future; current time before release date
expected_result: Material remains scheduled and is omitted from student view

purpose: Assignment Immediate Release and On-Time Submission: Draft -> Available -> On-Time Submission -> Status Submitted
preconditions: Course exists; Faculty creates draft assignment
action_or_input: Faculty publishes immediately; Student submits work before deadline
expected_result: Assignment available immediately; Student submission created with status=submitted

purpose: Assignment Immediate Release with Late Submission: Draft -> Available -> Submission after due date -> Status Late
preconditions: Assignment is published; due_date has passed

purpose: Assignment Scheduled Release and On-Time Submission: Draft -> Scheduled -> Release event -> Available -> On-Time Submission
preconditions: Faculty creates assignment scheduled for future release
action_or_input: Release time arrives; assignment becomes available; Student submits on-time
expected_result: Assignment transitions to available; Student submits on-time successfully

purpose: Assignment Scheduled Release: Attempt to access or submit before release date is blocked
preconditions: Assignment has status=scheduled with release date in future
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit work to scheduled assignment

purpose: Faculty Grading and Grade Release: Submission -> Faculty evaluates -> Draft Grade -> Faculty releases -> Released Grade -> Student views
preconditions: Student submission exists; User is Faculty
action_or_input: Faculty enters score -> grade held in draft -> Faculty triggers release -> Student reads score
expected_result: Grade transitions from draft to released; student can read score and feedback

purpose: Faculty Grading Hold: Submission -> Faculty evaluates -> Draft Grade -> Grade unreleased -> Hidden from student
preconditions: Grade created in draft status by Faculty
action_or_input: Student queries grades before release action
expected_result: Draft grade is withheld / not visible to student

purpose: TA Grading and Faculty Grade Release: Submission -> TA evaluates -> Draft Grade (attributed to TA) -> Faculty releases -> Released Grade
preconditions: Student submission exists; Users are TA and Faculty
action_or_input: TA grades submission -> Grade saved with graded_by_user_id=TA -> Faculty releases grades
expected_result: Grade transitions to released with TA attribution preserved and Faculty release recorded

purpose: TA Grading and Unauthorized TA Release Attempt: Submission -> TA evaluates -> TA attempts release -> Rejected -> Remains Draft
preconditions: Draft grade exists; User is TA
expected_result: Raises GradeReleaseAuthorityViolation; Grade remains in draft status

purpose: Assignment Publication and Submission Composite Lifecycle: Create -> Schedule -> Immediate Publish -> Student Submit -> Validate Final State
preconditions: CourseWorkspace exists with enrolled Faculty and Student
action_or_input: Full sequential workflow from assignment creation to submission
expected_result: Entire lifecycle completes cleanly in order

purpose: Grading, Grade Release, and Post-Release Modification Composite Lifecycle: Submission -> TA Grading -> Faculty Release -> Post-Release Modification -> Audit Log
preconditions: Student submission exists; TA and Faculty enrolled
action_or_input: Full sequential grading workflow with post-release score change and audit log verification
expected_result: All steps succeed and GradeChangeLog captures modification details
